description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4' and provides a method to validate IPv6 addresses within the context of an HTML purifier library. It includes logic for prefix, compatibility, and compression checks, and ensures the address is properly formatted.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6
classes.description: A class that validates an IPv6 address, extending an IPv4 validation class and implementing IPv6-specific validation logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided IPv6 address string against various criteria, including prefix, IPv4-compatibility, and compression, returning the original address if valid or false if invalid.
